name: Christopher D. Smith
source:
Although he's an international student, he's lived in Japan for a long time, so his Japanese is excellent. He's had feelings for the protagonist since they first met and takes care of him.

Hobbies: Knitting
Favorite Food: Original blend of herb tea, Sushi (except for shellfish)
Family: A brother who is one year older than him.

[Translated & edited from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20050209132936/http://www.baron-game.jp/chara1.htm]official website[/url]]
